description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseMessage' used in API requests within the 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.PublicApi' namespace. It contains a protected GUID for correlation purposes and a public method to access it.

classes.name: BaseMessage
classes.description: An abstract base class for API request messages, providing a unique correlation identifier.

methods.name: CorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the GUID identifier used for logging and correlation in API requests.
